meson_options.description: Setup multiple buildtype-suffixed ninja-backend build directories, and a [builddir]_vs containing a Visual Studio meta-backend with multiple configurations that calls into them
meson_options.name: genvslite

meson_options.description: Enable debug symbols and other information
meson_options.name: debug

meson_options.description: Default umask to apply on permissions of installed files
meson_options.name: install_umask

meson_options.description: Whether to try static linking before shared linking
meson_options.name: prefer_static

meson_options.description: Which python environment to install to
meson_options.name: python.install_env

meson_options.description: Whether to allow use of the Python Limited API
meson_options.name: python.allow_limited_api

meson_options.description: Config file containing the build details for the target Python installation.
meson_options.name: python.build_config

meson_options.description: List of additional paths for pkg-config to search
meson_options.name: pkg_config_path

meson_options.description: List of additional prefixes for cmake to search
meson_options.name: cmake_prefix_path

meson_options.description: Maximum number of linker processes to run or 0 for no limit
meson_options.name: backend_max_links

meson_options.description: Directory to store ThinLTO cache objects
meson_options.name: b_thinlto_cache_dir

meson_options.description: Use multiple threads for Link Time Optimization
meson_options.name: b_lto_threads

meson_options.description: Use LLVM ThinLTO caching for faster incremental builds
meson_options.name: b_thinlto_cache

meson_options.description: Build static libraries as position independent
meson_options.name: b_staticpic

meson_options.description: Extra arguments passed to the c compiler
meson_options.name: c_args

meson_options.description: Extra arguments passed to the c linker
meson_options.name: c_link_args

meson_options.description: Extra arguments passed to the cpp compiler
meson_options.name: cpp_args

meson_options.description: Extra arguments passed to the cpp linker
meson_options.name: cpp_link_args

meson_options.description: Enable embedded mode (minimal dependencies, smaller binary)
meson_options.name: embedded

meson_options.description: Enable Arrow IPC support (for data serialization and network transport)
meson_options.name: ipc

meson_options.description: Threading backend: native (auto-detect C11/POSIX) or posix (force pthreads, required for TSan)
meson_options.name: threads

meson_options.description: Build parser fuzz target and corpus smoke test when using Clang/libFuzzer (Issue #743)
meson_options.name: enable_fuzz

meson_options.description: Default CRC-32 variant: ethernet (standard) or castagnoli (iSCSI)
meson_options.name: crc32_variant

meson_options.description: Enable optional CLI plugin loader via dlopen (Issue #461). Excluded from Android/iOS.
meson_options.name: io_plugin_dlopen

meson_options.description: Build for Android (NDK cross-compile, Issue #464). When true: excludes wirelog_cli, adds -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384 on aarch64 for 16 KB page compatibility (Android 14+). Symbol visibility remains hidden -- WIRELOG_API on public headers already covers Android exports. Use with meson --cross-file cross/android-arm64.ini (or android-x86_64.ini).
meson_options.name: android

meson_options.description: Build for iOS. Disables executable targets and plugin loading, and applies Apple iOS target flags.
meson_options.name: ios

meson_options.description: Use system-installed mbedTLS for cryptographic functions. auto=enabled if found, else disabled. Enabling links Apache-2.0 mbedTLS and brings cryptography into the build (see docs/SECURITY_MODEL.md): the artifact then carries ECCN 5D002.c.1 under U.S. EAR; downstream redistributors are responsible for any export filings under their own jurisdiction. Default-disabled builds carry no cryptographic code (EAR99).
meson_options.name: mbedTLS

meson_options.description: Explicit single-prefix metadata-free mbedTLS installation to use after pkg-config/CMake discovery fails (native builds only).
meson_options.name: mbedTLS_prefix

meson_options.description: Compile-time ceiling for WL_LOG() (Issue #287). Set to "error" in release for zero-cost disabled TRACE/DEBUG/INFO/WARN sites.
meson_options.name: wirelog_log_max_level

meson_options.description: Build IPC libraries with LZ4 compression support
meson_options.name: nanoarrow:ipc_with_lz4

meson_options.description: Build IPC libraries with ZSTD compression support
meson_options.name: nanoarrow:ipc_with_zstd

meson_options.description: Switch multi-branch finalization stage of XXH32 by a single jump
meson_options.name: xxhash:32-endjmp

meson_options.description: See DISPATCH=1 for information about xxh_x86dispatch.c
meson_options.name: xxhash:dispatch

meson_options.description: Use a faster direct read path when input is aligned
meson_options.name: xxhash:force-align-check

meson_options.description: Include compilation of algorithms relying on 64-bit types
meson_options.name: xxhash:long-long

meson_options.description: Prefixes all symbols with the value of XXH_NAMESPACE
meson_options.name: xxhash:namespace

meson_options.description: Manually select a vector instruction set
meson_options.name: xxhash:vector

meson_options.description: Removes symbols related to XXH3 (both 64 & 128 bits) from generated binary
meson_options.name: xxhash:xxh3

meson_options.description: Whether to print the logs from failing tests
meson_options.name: errorlogs

meson_options.description: Split stdout and stderr in test logs
meson_options.name: stdsplit
